name: time-machine
description: Agent Time Machine: a branching timeline of tool calls with shadow-git snapshots — inspect, diff, explain test failures, restore, branch, compare, re-run

storeDir.title: Store directory
storeDir.description: Where snapshots and timelines are kept, one folder per project (empty: ~/.claude/time-machine)

retentionDays.title: Keep sessions for (days)
retentionDays.description: Recorded sessions older than this are deleted at session start, at most once a day (0 keeps everything)

recordModelOutput.title: Record model text
recordModelOutput.description: Store the model's response text and the prompt head with each turn (off: lengths and hashes only)

skipSearchBash.title: Skip snapshots after search commands
skipSearchBash.description: Do not snapshot after Bash commands classified as search (rg, grep, ls, cat …); off snapshots every Bash, since a redirect can still write
